description: NPC routines (packages/core/docs/npc-routines.md §3): which authored block of an NPC’s day is open at this hour on this day, what goal that block holds open and what it is worth, where it wants them to be, and what a preemption does to all of it. Each kb mirrors packages/core/src/routines/routine-predicates.ts verbatim and is regenerated by `npm run routine-corpus`. The pack is a COMPOSITION pack: it adds clauses for goal_requires/2 and condition_met/2, which ai/planning-predicates.ts declares :- dynamic, so a KB must consult the substrate first — the cases here declare both dynamic themselves, exactly as the shipped pack does, which is what lets them run standalone. A window is start-INCLUSIVE and end-EXCLUSIVE, and an end at or before the start WRAPS midnight so the night watch is one block rather than two; the absence of a routine_block_day/2 fact is what "every day" means, and the weekday is day_number mod routine_week_length so a ten-day week is authored rather than compiled in. The whole of what a routine contributes to behaviour is routine_goal/3 — a goal id and a number, which the decision layer writes as one agent_goal/3 fact for the substrate’s planner to serve. There is no routine action, no routine step and no routine utility, because a routine that could name an action would be the second selection mechanism the module exists not to be. A block’s place is a REQUIREMENT of its goal in the planner’s own condition vocabulary, and the condition atom IS the location atom, met by at_location/2 — traversal’s predicate, not a routine-private copy of it. What is NOT here is adoption, preemption and resumption: no rule computes those, they are what RoutineDirector remembers, and US-4’s conformance/routines/ is the artifact a native port diffs them against.

cases.name: due-inside-the-window-of-an-ordinary-block
kb: routine_weekday(W) :- day_number(D), routine_week_length(N), N > 0, W is D mod N.
routine_hour_in(H, Start, End) :- Start < End, !, H >= Start, H < End.
routine_hour_in(H, Start, End) :- ( H >= Start ; H < End ), !.
routine_window_open(B) :- routine_block_window(B, Start, End), time_of_day(H), routine_hour_in(H, Start, End).
routine_due(A, B) :- nonvar(A), follows_routine(A, R), routine_block(R, B), routine_window_open(B), routine_day_matches(B).
routine_goal(A, G, P) :- routine_due(A, B), \+ routine_suspended(A, _), routine_block_goal(B, G), routine_block_priority(B, P).
goal_requires(G, Place) :- routine_block_goal(B, G), routine_block_place(B, Place).
condition_met(A, Place) :- routine_block_place(_, Place), at_location(A, Place).
routine_destination(A, Place) :- routine_due(A, B), routine_block_place(B, Place).
